thread:
Sam Patel: quick heads-up — trying to onboard mistral-quant-v2 and CI is failing on config lint. error points to weights_uri mismatch and missing tokenizer defaults. anyone seen this pattern before?

Devon Chen: can you paste the failing snippet?

Sam Patel: sure — here's the relevant part from configs/mistral-quant-v2/config.json:```json
{
  "model_name": "mistral-quant-v2",
  "weights_uri": "s3://models/redwood/mistral/quant/v2/weights.pt",
  "tokenizer": {
    "tokenizer_file": "s3://models/redwood/mistral/tokenizer.json",
    "special_tokens_map": {
      "pad_token": "<|pad|>"
    }
  }
}
```

Sam Patel: the lint output: `SchemaError: weights_uri must start with s3://redwood-models/ or gs://...` and `TokenizerWarning: pad_token_id missing -> defaulting to 0 (might break embedding alignment)`

config-lint-bot: config-lint failure on configs/mistral-quant-v2/config.json — rule: weights_uri_prefix (code 402), rule: tokenizer_special_tokens (code 210). See CI details: https://ci.redwood/internal/1234

Anya Rodriguez: ah, we tightened the allowed bucket prefixes last week (dedicated infra move). old onboarding guide uses s3://models/..., new canonical path is s3://redwood-models/<team>/<model>/...

Linh Tran: for tokenizer — the schema now requires special_tokens_map to include token ids or else we add explicit defaults at load time. two options: 1) update config to include pad_token_id, eos_token_id etc. 2) update model-onboarding script to infer ids from tokenizer file and inject defaults before lint (recommended for legacy configs).

Devon Chen: simpler short-term fix: change weights_uri to s3://redwood-models/mistral/mistral-quant-v2/weights.pt (also add trailing .index? check loader). And add pad_token_id: 1 in tokenizer block.

Sam Patel: ok i'll try that and push a tiny patch. question: do we want a migration helper for other old configs? there are a few repos with the old s3 prefix.

Anya Rodriguez: yes — add a small migration script under tools/model-migrations that rewrites known prefixes. Also add a lint rule exemption that suggests the migration command: `tools/model-migrations/migrate-bucket-prefix --apply configs/*.json`

Linh Tran: for long-term we should update the schema to accept both prefixes but emit a warning with a one-click codemod link. Otherwise folks will keep hardcoding the wrong bucket.

Sam Patel: PR up: #3124 with the config changes and a unit test. CI still showing tokenizer warning (non-fatal) but weights error gone. pinging @Anya for review.

Anya Rodriguez: on it. quick checklist: verify weights presence in the new bucket (infra will copy once PR merged), add entry to onboarding checklist (weights path + tokenizer ids), and notify support for customers who referenced the old s3 path.

Devon Chen: small nit — in the PR description include the exact `make config-lint` command you ran and the failing output before/after. saves back-and-forth.

Sam Patel: done. added `make config-lint` logs and the patch. CI green for lint now, still waiting on infra copy job. thanks all :thumbsup:

config-lint-bot: CI job success: lint stage passed for configs/mistral-quant-v2/config.json (build 5498).

Linh Tran: can we also add a test in config-schema-tests that loads tokenizer.json and asserts that special tokens map -> ids mapping is stable? if tokenization changes we want a regression alert.

Anya Rodriguez: yes — add an integration test that calls tools/tokenizer-verify --config <config> and compares token ids against a golden mapping. put it under tests/eng-ml/ so it runs in PRs.

Sam Patel: will add tests in follow-up PR. for now marking this thread resolved — thanks for the quick triage. :white_check_mark:
